title: Out of Time: code, pre-registrations, claim ledger and recorded runs
description:
Code, pre-registrations with their logs, claim ledger and recorded runs of an out-of-time evaluation of the tabular foundation models TabPFN-3 and TabICLv2 beside a weight-of-evidence scorecard and a tuned gradient-boosting model, on the origination vintages of Lending Club and of Freddie Mac's Single-Family Loan-Level Dataset. Discrimination is read on the scored cohorts as they age, and calibration and population stability beside it, against kill criteria fixed in the pre-registrations, by dated amendment where they changed, before any foundation-model run they judge. Every recorded run carries a manifest with the commit it ran at, the machine and sha256 hashes; README.md says which hashes each kind of run records. No row of either dataset is included. The data are provided by Freddie Mac; the results are the author's own.

Licences by path, as README.md states: the code under the MIT licence; the recorded runs on the Freddie Mac book (directories of experiments/ whose name contains -fm-, and experiments/2026-09-25-paper-tables/) under CC BY-NC 4.0; all other text, figures and outputs under CC BY 4.0. The record's licence field names the most restrictive of the three.
